title: Sr Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. Adobe is listed as Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” for 20 consecutive years. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.
  
  
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give global brands everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about transforming how companies interact with customers across every screen.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Adobe Experience Platform and Apps powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across channels.
  
  
The Forward Deployed Engineer sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You’ll work directly with Adobe’s strategic customers to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build solutions that accelerate adoption.
  
  
You’ll operate in a multi-functional Customer Pod with end-to-end ownership, partnering with customers, product teams, and engineers to turn complex problems into working solutions.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Partner with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives.
* Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.
* Investigate and resolve production-level platform issues across data ingestion, identity resolution, journey orchestration, and audience activation.
* Design and validate enterprise solutions spanning AEP, AJO, Marketo, and adjacent Adobe systems.
* Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that build customer trust.
* Prototype, experiment, and iterate rapidly, using AI-assisted tools as part of your everyday workflow.
* Connect customer needs with product and engineering teams, bringing field insights back into the product roadmap.
* Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through implementation, launch, and expansion.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
We hire for demonstrated impact and experience. You’ll bring a combination of technical depth, customer empathy, and collaborative problem solving.
  
  

* Hands-on engineering: You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your architecture decisions are grounded in implementation experience.
* Customer empathy: You understand customers’ goals, constraints, and definitions of success and build trusted relationships through empathy and technical expertise.
* Collaboration and communication: You work effectively with engineers, architects, product managers, and leaders and communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Enterprise architecture: You design end-to-end solutions across products and systems, considering integration, scale, security, and production requirements.
* Data expertise: You understand how data is structured, modeled, and moved and can evaluate trade-offs in schema design, identity resolution, and data pipelines.
* AI fluency and continuous learning: You embrace AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent to design, prototype, and deliver solutions.
* Proactive problem solving: You identify emerging challenges and take initiative to move them toward resolution.

What You Need to Succeed
  
  

* 10+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science or a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with CDP, MDM, martech, or data platforms.
* Experience with data governance, privacy-preserving computation, or secure data collaboration.
* Familiarity with identity resolution or customer data unification.
* Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Temporal, Step Functions, or similar.
* Experience contributing to architecture decisions or technical strategy at the team or organizational level.
* Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products such as AEP, AJO, Marketo, CJA, or Target is helpful.
* Experience working in regulated industries such as Financial Services, Healthcare, or Government is also helpful.

Why This Team
  
  
You’ll solve complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact and see your solutions reach production. You’ll combine architecture, engineering, strategy, and customer engagement while working with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global platform teams.
  
  
You’ll also help shape an engineering engagement model centered on rapid experimentation, customer feedback, and AI-assisted execution.
  
  
Come build the next generation of enterprise customer experiences with us!
  
  
Adobe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status.
  
  
**About Adobe**
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  
Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  
Let’s Adobe together
  
  
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  
Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  
Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.
  
  
AI Use Guidelines for Interviews
  
  
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
  
  
At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

title: Data Solutions Architect 3rd
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
A career in our Business Intelligence practice, within Data and Analytics Technology services, will provide you with the opportunity to help organizations uncover enterprise insights and drive business results using smarter data analytics. Leveraging a collection of organizational technology capabilities, including business intelligence, data management, and data assurance, we help our clients drive innovation, growth, and change within their organization using business intelligence.
  
  
Our rapid business intelligence solutions, data visualization, and integrated reporting dashboards allow our team to deliver agile, highly interactive reporting and analytics that help our clients to run their business, understand what business questions can be answered and how to unlock the business drivers more effectively.
  
  
**Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:**
Crowe is looking for a Data Solutions Architect to be a leader on our team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience. The primary focus will be helping our clients solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  
  

* The shift timings for this role is 5:00PM - 2:00AM IST (7:30AM - 4:30PM ET)
* Serve as subject matter expert on Business Intelligence engineering platforms (Ex - Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Data platform, Snowflake, DBT) demonstrating platform capabilities and promoting application of toolset to address business needs and maximize the value realized from technology investment.
* Oversee the design and deployment of data pipelines, analytics platforms, and reporting frameworks that improve transparency and support decision-making.
* Utilize advanced analytics, machine learning, and statistical modeling techniques to detect anomalous activity and patterns in transaction data.
* Ensure data quality and integrity through best practices in data management and governance.
* Mentor and lead a team of data analysts and consultants, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Provide technical guidance and career development opportunities to junior team members, ensuring high levels of performance and professional growth.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration among teams to integrate data-driven insights into broader business strategies.
* Develop and implement frameworks that align with regulatory changes and help clients stay ahead of compliance requirements.
* Work with legal and compliance teams to translate regulatory requirements into actionable data analytics strategies.
* Contribute to proposals and presentations for potential clients, demonstrating expertise in data analytics and regulatory compliance.
* Represent the organization at industry events and conferences as a subject matter expert in data consulting.
* Drive internal innovation by identifying emerging technologies and methodologies that can improve service delivery.
* Participate in presales engagements to manage the vision and expectations of a client’s multiple stakeholders and create a conceptual solution design involving effort estimation, technical and functional solution, execution methodology, project plan, and team.
* Participate in the systems development process, including planning and monitoring systems development efforts, coordinating activities with other groups, reviewing deliverables and communicating status to the project manager and client.
* Lead and provide technical guidance and mentorship to other team members.
* Architect, implement, deploy, and support analytical databases and pipelines in an Azure environment
* Create proofs of concepts as necessary for architectural vision, strategy, and tool evaluation.
* Document, diagram, and present complex/technical material that can be understood by a non-technical audience.
* Create and deploy accurate client architecture and analyses in a relatively short period of time.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics or a related field is required.
* Advanced degree (Master’s/Ph.D.) is preferred.
* At least 7–10 years of progressive experience in data analytics, consulting, or financial services; a strong background in banking and regulatory compliance implementations is desired.
* Proven track record in managing complex data projects and leading cross-functional teams.
* Experience in working with large datasets, data warehousing, and advanced analytics tools.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise data warehouse and data lake implementations
* 5+ years of external client consulting experience
* 5+ years of hands-on experience building automated ETL/ELT or data integration processes utilizing multiple source systems
* 5+ years of team management experience (including offshore resources)
* 5+ years of experience leading multiple external client projects simultaneously
* 5+ years of preparing detailed external client project budget estimations with strong resource management capabilities
* 3+ years of in-depth experience in architecting, designing, and implementing complex data architectures on Azure including Azure Data Factory, Azure/Managed Instance SQL Server, Azure Logic App, and Azure Synapse Analytics
* Experience mentoring teammates or conducting technical training
* Possess integrity and a strong work ethic
* Strong analytical and verbal/written communication skills

**Certifications (Preferred):**

* Certifications in BI (ETL tools, visualization tools, cloud architectures) are expected
* Certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist), CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), or related data analytics certifications are a plus.

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Experience working in or consulting for financial services clients is highly desirable.
* Hands-on experience with comprehensive dimensional modelling and end-to-end data warehouse projects, including:

+ Requirements gathering
+ Infrastructure planning and deployment
+ Subject matter expert interviews
+ Logical and physical dimensional model design and development
+ ETL/ELT development and maintenance model and data validation
+ Documentation

* Previous consulting experience or experience working with external clients
* Proficiency in analytics and statistical programming languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL).
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and big data technologies.
* Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and cloud-based data platforms is advantageous
* Experience working on projects using agile development practices
* Azure experience: building landing zones, provisioning resources, establishing security is a big plus

**Key Stakeholders This Role Interacts With:**
**Internal**

* Senior BI Analyst
* Data Product Manager
* BI Architect / Senior Architect
* Data Engineers
* Analytics Developers (Power BI, Tableau)

**External**

* C-Suite Executives (CEO, CFO, CIO, etc.)
* Clients Operations Leads and Mid-Level Managers
* Data Owners, Data Stewards
* Enterprise Information Management and Data Governance Team

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
  
  
Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
  
  
We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Sr. Golang Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a Senior Backend & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong expertise in Golang to build scalable cloud infrastructure, production-grade microservices, and distributed systems.
  
  
**Job Location**
- Base location would be Jaipur, work location would be Client Location - Gurugram /Noida
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain production-grade microservices using Golang.
* Build cloud infrastructure services, including:

+ Kubernetes-as-a-Service (KaaS)
+ Bare Metal-as-a-Service (BMaaS)
+ Network-as-a-Service (NaaS)
+ NAT Gateway-as-a-Service

* Design and implement highly available, scalable, and reliable distributed systems.
* Develop service-to-service communication APIs using gRPC and Protobuf.
* Build backend services and APIs using Python and FastAPI, wherever required.
* Work with MongoDB for distributed data storage and management.
* Integrate backend services with Kubernetes, compute, networking, and infrastructure layers.
* Troubleshoot and resolve performance, reliability, and production issues.
* Contribute to infrastructure automation, system optimization, and operational reliability.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in backend development or software engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Golang.
* Solid understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
* Hands-on experience with gRPC and Protobuf.
* Experience working with MongoDB.
* Good understanding of Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with Python and FastAPI.
* Understanding of Linux systems and networking fundamentals.
* Experience building scalable, reliable, and production-ready systems.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with AWS, OpenStack, or similar cloud platforms.
* Experience developing Kubernetes operators and controllers.
* Knowledge of bare-metal provisioning and infrastructure management.
* Understanding of networking concepts such as VPC, routing, NAT, DNS, VLAN, and VXLAN.
* Experience with infrastructure automation, monitoring, and observability.

**Technology Stack**

* Golang, Python, FastAPI, Kubernetes, gRPC, Protobuf, MongoDB, Microservices, Distributed Systems, Cloud Infrastructure, Linux, and Networking.

title: Director IT Operations
description:
**Director of IT Operations – Private Cloud & Infrastructure**

**Company:**
Iridium Cloud Systems Private Limited (cdmon India)

**Location:**

Greater Noida - West

**Designation Offered:**
GM- IT Operation/Head of IT Operarion/ Director of IT Operations

* **Department:**
  IT Operations
* **Reports To:**
  CEO
* **Employment Type:**
  Full-Time
* **Experience:**
  17+ Years in IT Infrastructure & Operations | 10+ Years in Leadership
* **Max CTC: Upto INR 40 LPA Fixed**

**About cdmon**

Iridium Cloud Systems Private Limited (cdmon India) is part of cdmon Barcelona, a leading European provider of hosting, cloud infrastructure, domain registration, VPS, and digital services. We are expanding our global infrastructure capabilities and are looking for an experienced technology leader to drive the next phase of operational excellence, private cloud transformation, automation, reliability, and international growth.

**Position Overview**

The Director of IT Operations will be responsible for leading the organization's global IT Operations function, ensuring the reliability, security, scalability, and cost-efficiency of our hosting and cloud infrastructure platforms.

This role requires a unique blend of deep technical expertise, operational leadership, financial management, and strategic thinking. The successful candidate will lead the evolution of our infrastructure from traditional systems administration toward highly automated, cloud-native, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) driven operations.

The ideal candidate has significant experience managing Linux-based infrastructure, Private Cloud environments built on OpenStack and Proxmox, large-scale hosting platforms, cybersecurity, data center operations, and globally distributed operations teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Governance**

* Define and execute the IT Operations strategy aligned with company objectives and international growth plans.
* Develop operational policies, governance frameworks, and infrastructure standards.
* Drive infrastructure modernization initiatives focused on scalability, resilience, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Establish long-term technology roadmaps for hosting, cloud, virtualization, networking, storage, and security platforms.
* Lead strategic vendor relationships with hardware suppliers, connectivity providers, data centers, cloud technology partners, and open-source communities.
* Manage departmental CAPEX and OPEX budgets while ensuring optimal ROI on infrastructure investments.
* Develop cost optimization strategies without compromising service quality or reliability.

**Private Cloud & Infrastructure Leadership**

* Own the architecture, operations, and evolution of the company's Private Cloud platforms.
* Lead infrastructure strategy around:
* OpenStack
* Proxmox VE
* KVM Virtualization
* Ceph Storage
* Linux-based Infrastructure
* Cloud Orchestration Platforms
* Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and performance across all production environments.
* Oversee compute, storage, networking, backup, disaster recovery, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
* Drive cloud automation and Infrastructure-as-Code initiatives.
* Define capacity planning methodologies and long-term infrastructure forecasting.

**Operations Excellence**

* Ensure smooth execution of:
* Service Operations
* Capacity Management
* Continuity & Availability Management
* Incident & Problem Management
* Change Management
* Establish operational maturity models across:
* Monitoring
* Alerting
* Redundancy
* Disaster Recovery
* Security
* Software Lifecycle Management
* Lead root cause analysis for major incidents.
* Drive continuous service improvement programs.
* Implement best practices aligned with ITIL, SRE, and modern operations frameworks.

**SRE & Automation Transformation**

* Lead the transition from traditional SysAdmin operations to Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
* Drive automation of repetitive operational tasks.
* Reduce operational toil through tooling, scripting, orchestration, and self-healing infrastructure.
* Promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using modern automation frameworks.
* Establish reliability engineering principles and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).

**Cybersecurity & Compliance**

* Ensure security of infrastructure, systems, applications, and customer environments.
* Lead security initiatives including:
* DDoS Protection
* WAF Management
* Vulnerability Management
* Security Hardening
* Threat Mitigation
* Ensure compliance with:
* GDPR
* ISO/IEC 27001
* Information Security Management Systems (ISMS)
* International Data Protection Regulations
* Collaborate closely with security and compliance teams.

**Global Operations Management**

* Design and implement a robust 24x7 operational support model.
* Establish Follow-the-Sun operational coverage where required.
* Build scalable operational structures supporting international growth.
* Standardize operational procedures across multiple geographies.
* Ensure seamless coordination between infrastructure, support, engineering, and product teams.

**Product & Business Alignment**

* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams.
* Assess operational readiness for new product launches.
* Ensure infrastructure scalability before commercial expansion initiatives.
* Contribute to strategic business planning through technology insights.
* Balance technical excellence with customer experience and business profitability.

**Leadership & People Development**

* Lead, mentor, and inspire high-performing IT Operations teams.
* Build a culture of:
* Ownership
* Accountability
* Innovation
* Continuous Learning
* Collaboration
* Drive talent development and succession planning.
* Support recruitment and retention of top technical talent.
* Facilitate cross-team knowledge sharing and technical excellence.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master's Degree is preferred.

**Professional Experience**

**Mandatory**

* 15+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure and Operations.
* 10+ years of leadership experience managing technical teams.
* Experience leading large-scale hosting, cloud, ISP, telecom, SaaS, or infrastructure organizations.
* Proven experience managing enterprise infrastructure budgets.

**Technical Expertise**

title: Tech S and T-DC Exit and Cloud Migration Consultant-ISR-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**DC Exit & Cloud Migration Consultant - Senior**
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking a highly skilled DC Exit & Cloud Migration Senior Consultant with 6+ years of strong experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure modernization, datacenter transformation, and cloud migration initiatives across enterprise environments. The role focuses on planning, assessing, designing, and executing datacenter exit and cloud migration programs to accelerate application modernization, infrastructure optimization, operational resilience, and cloud adoption for enterprise clients.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on cloud engineering expertise combined with consulting experience and the ability to drive migration assessments, transformation roadmaps, proof-of-concepts, and migration execution across complex hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Assess, design, and execute datacenter exit and cloud migration strategies for enterprise applications, infrastructure, databases, and platforms.
* Perform application portfolio assessments and define migration approaches including Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retain, Retire, and Replace strategies.
* Develop cloud migration roadmaps, transformation plans, landing zones, and migration wave planning for enterprise clients.
* Strong competency in cloud engineering across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, including infrastructure provisioning, modernization, and workload migration.
* Design and implement cloud-native architectures leveraging compute, storage, networking, security, containers, and platform services.
* Support migration discovery, dependency mapping, infrastructure assessment, capacity planning, and migration readiness activities.
* Develop automation solutions using Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Shell scripting, and Infrastructure as Code principles to accelerate migration programs.
* Execute application, server, database, storage, and platform migrations while ensuring business continuity and operational stability.
* Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, networking, and operations teams to align migration initiatives with enterprise governance standards.
* Support cloud modernization initiatives involving containers, Kubernetes, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and Platform Engineering practices.
* Design and execute migration proof-of-concepts (PoCs), pilot migrations, validation activities, and cloud transformation assessments.
* Develop migration dashboards, reporting frameworks, business cases, and executive presentations to support client engagements.
* Provide technical advisory support on cloud adoption, application modernization, landing zone architecture, cloud governance, and migration best practices.

title: Lead Software Development Engineer
description:
****Senior Software Engineer- DevOps for Workflow Innovation in Barco Control Rooms @Barco****
**BCR (Barco Control Rooms)**
The Barco Control Rooms business unit is making workflow and visualization solutions for the Control Room market since 1994 to help operators collect, visualize and share critical information for optimal mission-critical decision making. Today, we are still the number one choice for control room professionals who want to stay on top of their situational awareness with 12000+ installations for critical infrastructure and critical operations.
  
  
**Senior Software Engineer - DevOps for Workflow Innovation @ Barco**
We are seeking a hands-on DevOps Engineer to join the Barco CTRL Workflow Innovation team and support the development of a new AI-driven product from the ground up. The ideal candidate must have strong experience in GCP, cloud-native DevOps, and AI/MLOps practices, with proven ability to build reliable platforms, automation, CI/CD workflows, and deployment infrastructure for data and AI product capabilities. You will work with a globally distributed team to enable scalable, secure, and production-ready delivery of intelligent workflow solutions for Barco Control Rooms.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Software Engineer - DevOps in the Workflow Innovation team, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the cloud-native engineering foundation required to develop, test, deploy, and operate AI-driven product capabilities for Barco Control Rooms. This is not a classical DevOps role focused only on build pipelines and deployments; it requires hands-on experience with AI/MLOps, cloud infrastructure, data/AI workloads, automation, observability, and secure production operations. The role will also support deployment patterns where AI capabilities may need to run closer to the operational environment, including Edge AI scenarios, hybrid cloud-edge architectures, and efficient inference workflows for mission-critical control room use cases. You will collaborate with cloud partners, product owners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, and validation teams across locations to enable fast, reliable, and secure delivery of workflow innovation capabilities.
  
  

* Build and maintain cloud-native DevOps and AI/MLOps infrastructure for the Workflow Innovation product on GCP.
* Design and implement CI/CD workflows for backend services, data pipelines, AI/ML components, model integration, and GenAI-enabled capabilities.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, environment management, configuration, and deployment workflows using infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Enable deployment and operation of AI/ML workloads, including model serving, inference workflows, RAG-based components, vector search services, and related data/AI services.
* Support cloud-to-edge deployment and operational patterns for AI capabilities, including lightweight model packaging, inference deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management for Edge AI scenarios.
* Establish observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, reliability, and cost-awareness practices for cloud-native Data & AI product capabilities.
* Support secure handling of product data, secrets, access control, compliance needs, and cloud security best practices.
* Work closely with Data & AI engineers and product teams to improve developer experience, release readiness, test automation, and operational reliability.
* Guide and mentor fellow colleagues in DevOps, cloud, and AI/MLOps practices while contributing to technical discussions and engineering excellence.

****Qualifications and Experience****
**Education**
We are seeking experience with the following technologies/domains:
  
  
B. Tech./B. E./M. E./M. Tech. in Computer Science/AI Engineering
  
  
**Experience**

* 6-9 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud platform engineering, SRE, AI/MLOps, or related product engineering roles.
* Strong hands-on experience with GCP is required, including relevant cloud-native compute, storage, networking, IAM, observability, and deployment services.
* Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for cloud-native applications, backend services, data pipelines, and AI/ML workloads.
* Hands-on experience with AI/MLOps practices, including model deployment, model serving, inference workflows, experiment tracking, model versioning, and release automation for AI-enabled product features.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and environment automation using tools such as Terraform, Helm, or equivalent technologies.
* Good understanding of cloud security practices, including IAM, secrets management, network security, secure deployment patterns, and least-privilege access.
* Experience setting up monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, SLO/SLA-oriented reliability practices, and incident response workflows.
* Exposure to data and AI platforms or services such as BigQuery, Vertex AI Vector Search, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, vector databases, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience supporting RAG-based applications, GenAI-enabled services, model APIs, or AI inference platforms is highly desirable.
* Exposure to Edge AI concepts, hybrid cloud-edge deployments, on-device or near-device inference, model optimization, and operational constraints such as latency, reliability, connectivity, and resource usage is desirable.
* Good programming and scripting experience using Python, Bash, or similar languages, with ability to build automation and internal tooling.
* Understanding of DevSecOps practices, automated testing, quality gates, vulnerability scanning, dependency management, and secure software supply chain practices.
* Ability to collaborate with cloud partners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, product owners, and validation teams across geographies.
* Strong problem-solving mindset, ownership, operational discipline, and willingness to explore and adopt new technologies in AI, DevOps, and cloud engineering.

title: Technical Implementation Manager
description:
At Landis+Gyr, we're helping shape the future of energy—making it more intelligent, resilient, and sustainable.
  
  
As a global energy technology leader, we're accelerating the energy evolution through purposeful innovation and trusted partnerships. Trusted by more than 2,000 utilities worldwide, our intelligent solutions connect devices, data, and decisions across the grid, helping customers modernize infrastructure, optimize operations, and deliver energy that is more reliable, resilient, accessible, safe, and sustainable.
  
  
Behind every solution is a team of approximately 3,300 employees across more than 40 countries who are passionate about solving complex challenges, driving innovation, and making a meaningful impact for our utility customers and the communities they serve.
  
  
Join Team Green and help shape the future of intelligent energy.
  
  
**Technical Implementation Manager**
The Technical Implementation Manager (TIM) owns the technical delivery of Landis+Gyr's AMI products and solutions for new customer deployments and upgrades. The role covers both containerized deployments on Kubernetes (GKE and RKE), delivered using CI/CD pipelines and automation, and multi-tier deployments of the Head-End System (HES) across Windows and Linux servers. Across both, the TIM takes the Landis+Gyr solution from environment readiness through to production, covering the full stack from head-end software to field network endpoints.
  
  
Working closely with Program Managers, infrastructure teams, customer IT and operations teams, and Landis+Gyr engineering and product groups, the TIM is accountable for a successful go-live. This includes resolving technical issues that arise during deployment and the hypercare period, and transitioning the solution smoothly to the support organization. The role calls for deep hands-on DevOps expertise and a strong working knowledge of GCP, combined with the planning and customer-facing skills needed to deliver complex deployments on schedule.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end technical deployment of Landis+Gyr AMI solutions for new customers and upgrades, from environment readiness through go-live, planning activities with Program Managers and managing dependencies and risks.
* Validate that provisioned GCP and RKE environments meet deployment prerequisites, working with the infrastructure teams responsible for provisioning them.
* Deploy, configure and upgrade containerized applications on Kubernetes (GKE and RKE) using Docker and Helm charts.
* Install, configure and upgrade the Head-End System (HES) across its multi-tier architecture (network, metrology, web, application and adapter tiers) on Windows and Linux servers, including IIS and .NET-based components.
* Use and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or similar) and scripting (PowerShell, Bash) to automate deployment, upgrade and rollback, and build reusable deployment templates across customers.
* Set up monitoring, logging and alerting so deployed applications are production-ready at go-live.
* Deliver integrations between the Landis+Gyr head-end and customer enterprise systems (e.g., MDM, CIS).
* Lead System Acceptance Testing (SAT) for new deployments and upgrades, driving defects to resolution.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during deployment and hypercare through root cause analysis, engaging engineering, product, infrastructure and support teams as needed.
* Manage the formal handover to support teams, including operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer.
* Follow formal change control processes and keep ServiceNow records complete for deployment-phase changes and issues.
* Act as the customer's technical point of contact, leading technical workshops and liaising across Landis+Gyr business units throughout the deployment.

**Key Competencies**

* Automation-first mindset, making every deployment repeatable, version-controlled and scripted
* Proven ownership of complex deployments end to end, from planning through go-live
* Strong planning and prioritization skills across parallel workstreams
* Methodical analytical and troubleshooting skills, with sound technical judgment
* Clear, confident communicator with customer technical teams, both written and verbal
* Self-starter who works independently, collaborates across teams and performs under time pressure
* Willingness to travel to customer sites (~50%)

**Technical Skills**
**Required:**

* Kubernetes: deploying and managing production workloads on GKE and RKE (Rancher Kubernetes Engine)
* Containers and packaging: Docker, Helm charts
* CI/CD: working with and maintaining pipelines in Jenkins or similar tools
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP): strong working knowledge of core services, as a user of GCP-hosted environments
* Infrastructure as code: working knowledge of Terraform
* Scripting and automation: PowerShell, Bash
* Version control: Git
* Operating systems: Linux/Unix and Microsoft Windows Server, for application deployment
* Databases: Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL
* Networking: IP suite and wireless/RF/broadband communication technologies
* IIS and .NET Framework

**Preferred:**

* Monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)
* Hardware Security Modules (HSM) and load balancers
* Two-way AMI technology, from head-end software to field endpoints

**Qualifications – Education And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication, Computer Science or IT
* 10+ years of industry experience, including at least 6 years in DevOps, cloud-based or technical deployment roles
* Experience deploying multi-tier enterprise applications on Windows and Linux server environments
* Experience delivering solutions that combine software and hardware
* Customer-facing experience, including independent travel to customer sites
* Energy utility or AMI operations experience is a plus

We value and encourage diversity in our team. This position is open to all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, age, disability, sexual orientation, or background. We're committed to shaping a better future for everyone. Join Team Green and be part of what's next in energy.
**#TeamGreen**

title: Application Infrastructure Management Engineer / SME
description:
**Role purpose**
Provide application infrastructure expertise for business-critical applications, helping application owners, development teams, infrastructure teams and vendors understand how applications are hosted, integrated, monitored, recovered and operated. The role combines application knowledge, infrastructure understanding and architecture judgement to improve supportability, resilience and operational maturity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Assess application hosting environments, dependencies, interfaces and infrastructure components.
* Review application supportability across operating system, database, middleware, application server, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery and operational documentation.
* Identify operational gaps, technical risks, lifecycle issues and improvement opportunities.
* Work with application owners, development teams, infrastructure towers and vendors to define or refine the operating model.

* Help application teams move toward more standard, supportable and modern operating patterns where appropriate.
* Act as a trusted advisor to application owners by building knowledge of the application, business context, dependencies and operational sensitivities.
* Support critical incident reviews where application infrastructure, middleware, platform or dependency knowledge is required.

**Required Experience**

* Senior experience in application infrastructure, application operations, middleware, production engineering, application support or solution architecture.
* Strong understanding of how enterprise applications run across datacenter, virtualized, middleware, database, container and cloud environments.
* Experience evaluating legacy, non-standard and modern application stacks.
* Practical knowledge of application servers and middleware such as WebSphere, Tomcat, IIS, message queueing, Java, .NET, APIs and container-based platforms.
* Experience with operational readiness, dependency mapping, monitoring design, resilience, recovery planning and incident analysis.

* Experience with application performance monitoring, observability, monitoring, IT service management and DevOps tooling.

title: Cloud Architect

title: Azure Integration Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced L2 Azure Integration Engineer to provide operational support, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintenance for Azure-based integration services supporting critical banking and enterprise business processes. The role involves managing and troubleshooting Azure Logic Apps, Azure Automation Runbooks, Azure Storage services, and SFTP-based integrations, including investigating workflow failures, analyzing integration errors, troubleshooting file transfers, validating access and permissions, and restoring services within defined SLAs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**🔹 Azure Integration Operations & Monitoring**

* Provide L2 operational support for Azure-based integration services supporting critical banking and enterprise business processes
* Monitor and manage alerts across Azure Logic Apps, Azure Automation Runbooks, Azure Storage, SFTP, and related integration components
* Investigate recurring alerts and incidents and develop deeper technical expertise in the systems and components generating the highest volume of incidents
* Ensure effective monitoring, alert triage, incident ownership, and timely escalation within defined SLAs

**🔹 Workflow & Integration Troubleshooting**

* Investigate and troubleshoot failed Azure Logic Apps workflows, and integration processes
* Analyze workflow execution history, error messages, logs, and dependencies to identify root causes
* Troubleshoot issues across APIs, authentication, authorization, networking, and enterprise integration components
* Validate dependencies and restore failed services or workflows within defined SLAs

**🔹 SFTP & File Transfer Support**

* Troubleshoot SFTP-based integrations, including file transfer failures, connectivity issues, authentication problems, and file processing errors
* Investigate file delivery, pickup, naming, format, and processing issues across integrated systems
* Validate SFTP connectivity, credentials, permissions, and relevant network dependencies
* Coordinate with application, infrastructure, security, and third-party teams to resolve complex file transfer issues

**🔹 Azure Storage & Access Management**

* Troubleshoot issues related to Azure Storage Accounts, Blob Storage, file shares, and storage-based integrations
* Validate storage access, permissions, authentication, and connectivity
* Investigate failures related to file availability, access restrictions, storage configuration, and integration dependencies
* Support the resolution of RBAC, identity, and access-related issues impacting integrations

**🔹 API, Authentication & Network Troubleshooting**

* Troubleshoot integration issues involving REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, certificates, tokens, and service connectivity
* Analyze HTTP response codes, API failures, authentication errors, and integration dependencies
* Investigate network-related issues involving DNS, firewall rules, private endpoints, connectivity, and access controls
* Collaborate with relevant teams to resolve cross-platform integration incidents

**🔹 Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Collaborate with L1 support, Azure Engineering, RPA, Application, Network, Security, and business teams to resolve complex incidents
* Contribute to the development and improvement of runbooks, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and operational procedures
* Identify recurring failure patterns and recommend improvements to monitoring, alerting, automation, and service reliability
* Build deeper technical expertise in Azure and RPA, particularly across systems and components responsible for the highest volume of alerts and incidents

**Required Skills**

**🔹 Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with:
* **Azure Logic Apps**
  and workflow troubleshooting
* **Azure Automation Runbooks**
  and job execution monitoring
* **Azure Storage**
  services

**\*\*🔹 Certifications**

**- \*\*Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)\*\* or \*\*Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)\*\***

**- \*\*ITIL® 4 Foundation\*\* certification**

**- Additional certifications in \*\*Azure Security, DevOps, Automation, or Cloud Technologies\*\* are a plus**

title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Problems the team works on:**

* Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load.
* API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs.
* Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems.

**What you'll do:**

* Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time.
* Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams.
* Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed.
* Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work.
* Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries.

**What we're looking for:**

* Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production.
* A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services.
* Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management.
* Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production.
* A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow.

**Nice to have:**

* Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar.
* Familiarity with LLM inference serving (batching, streaming, GPU utilization).
* Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. title: Technical Delivery Director – Salesforce
description:
Technical Delivery Director - SalesforceAbout Mirketa

Mirketa is a U.S.-headquartered digital transformation, technology consulting, and product engineering company with a delivery center in Noida, India. We specialize in Salesforce consulting and implementation, AI/GenAI, cloud platforms, data engineering, enterprise integration, and custom applications. We also build enterprise products for healthcare, AI-powered case resolution, revenue management, and nonprofit organizations.

Position Overview

We seek a technically accomplished Technical Delivery Director – Salesforce to own end-to-end Salesforce solutioning and technical execution across an assigned portfolio of enterprise engagements. The Director will lead Technology Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, and engineering teams; own pre-sales technical proposals and estimates; and ensure solution quality, predictable delivery, and strong talent development. This is an engineering-led role, not merely project coordination.

1. End-to-End Technical Solutioning, RFPs & Estimation

·      Lead end-to-end technical solutioning from discovery through technical approval and project initiation, including requirements analysis, architecture, technology selection, integration design, build-versus-buy decisions, sizing, and implementation planning.

·      Own technical responses to RFPs/RFIs, proposal architecture, solution diagrams, assumptions, resource and staffing plans, effort estimates, and implementation timelines.

·      Lead business and technical discovery with clients, U.S. sales teams, Business Analysts, and solution architects; translate requirements into feasible Salesforce solution designs.

·      Validate platform constraints, data architecture, security, integration complexity, nonfunctional requirements, risks, and delivery feasibility before commitments are made.

·      Act as technical solution owner through pre-sales handover; ensure proposed solutions are scalable, commercially viable, and executable by the engineering team.

·      Participate in technical workshops, client solution presentations, and proposal defenses; refine estimates using actual delivery benchmarks.

2. End-to-End Salesforce Technical Delivery

·      Own Salesforce technical execution across concurrent implementation, modernization, integration, and enhancement projects, from design and build through testing, deployment, and stabilization.

·      Manage Technology Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, and engineering teams, ensuring delivery against approved scope, effort budgets, timelines, and quality standards.

·      Identify technical blockers and delivery risks early; lead recovery of troubled projects, complex integrations, and critical platform issues.

·      Coordinate with Program Delivery, PM/BA, QA, DevOps, and U.S. client stakeholders on dependencies, releases, and acceptance.

3. Portfolio Governance & Project Reviews

·      Run weekly technical portfolio reviews covering milestone status, estimate-to-actual variance, remaining effort, staffing, defects, dependencies, and risks.

·      Own technical forecasts and corrective actions; ensure Technology Managers maintain credible engineering plans and proactively escalate threats to delivery.

·      Provide clear portfolio reporting to the VP Engineering & Technical Delivery and collaborate with Program Delivery on project controls and change management.

4. Salesforce Architecture & Quality

·      Own architecture quality and standards, reviewing data models, security/sharing, scalability, governor limits, integrations, platform performance, and design tradeoffs.

·      Guide appropriate choices between configuration and customization; ensure Apex, LWC, Flow, SOQL, event-driven and asynchronous patterns are fit for purpose.

·      Enforce peer reviews, unit and regression testing, CI/CD, source control, environment management, and release quality gates.

·      Lead defect root-cause reviews, reduce rework and technical debt, and promote reusable architecture patterns and engineering accelerators.

·      Provide technical judgment on Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud and, where relevant, Health Cloud, Field Service, Revenue Cloud, Data Cloud, and Agentforce.

5. Delivery Economics & Resource Planning

·      Own engineering effort budgets, estimates, delivery efficiency, utilization, capacity plans, and staffing for assigned projects.

·      Work with Finance and Program Delivery to monitor margin performance, effort variance, productivity, and corrective measures.

·      Forecast demand for Salesforce skills and align technical staffing to pipeline and delivery commitments.

6. Hiring, Leadership & Culture

·      Own technical hiring requirements and assessments across junior, mid-level, senior, and leadership positions; personally interview Technology Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, and senior Salesforce engineers.

·      Partner with HR on sourcing, competency models, technical assessments, onboarding, career paths, development plans, and employee retention.

·      Mentor technical managers and leads; establish regular coaching, meaningful 1:1s, performance feedback, succession plans, and collaborative engineering practices.

·      Build a high-performing, accountable culture with strong technical ownership, merit-based recognition, continuous learning, and innovation.

7. Salesforce Capability Development & Innovation

·      Establish domain-specific architecture patterns, reference solutions, internal training, certification priorities, and reusable implementation assets.

·      Develop capabilities in Agentforce and Salesforce AI, AI-assisted development and testing, and integrations with Python, AI services, cloud, and data platforms.

·      Collaborate with AI/Data and Cloud Technical Delivery Directors on cross-technology solutions.

8. Client Engagement & Escalations

·      Serve as senior technical counterpart for Salesforce clients, clearly presenting architecture tradeoffs, risks, estimates, and recovery plans.

·      Own critical technical escalations and contribute to client trust, delivery acceptance, and account growth.

Required Qualifications

·      12–16+ years in enterprise software engineering and technical delivery, including significant hands-on Salesforce development and solution architecture.

·      5+ years in Salesforce architecture or senior technical leadership; 4–6+ years managing Engineering Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, or sizeable engineering teams.

·      Demonstrated experience leading multiple enterprise Salesforce projects and organizations of approximately 30–60 technical professionals.

·      Deep knowledge of Apex, LWC, Flow, SOQL, Salesforce security/sharing, integration patterns, governor limits, and DevOps/CI-CD.

·      Proven personal ownership of technical solutioning, enterprise RFPs, architecture selection, estimates, staffing plans, implementation feasibility, and delivery handover.

·      Experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud; strong ability to challenge designs, engineering estimates, and technical decisions.

·      Accountability for technical effort budgets, quality metrics, engineering capacity, client escalations, and manager development.

·      Excellent communication with U.S. enterprise stakeholders; ability to work on-site in Noida every working day during core business hours.

·      Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Technical Architect (CTA), or related advanced credentials

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

·      Health Cloud, Field Service, Revenue Cloud, Data Cloud, and/or Agentforce experience.

·      Salesforce-native ISV packaging, managed packages, and OEM product architecture.

·      Complex integration, data migration, AI/GenAI, Python, Azure/AWS, or cloud data-platform experience.

·      Track record of rescuing troubled projects, building engineering practices, and attracting mid- and senior-level Salesforce talent.

Key Performance Indicators

**Area/**
**Measures**

**Technical solutioning /**

Solution quality, architecture feasibility, technical win support, post-kickoff design changes, estimation accuracy

**Delivery predictability /**

On-time milestones, forecast and schedule variance, delivery acceptance

**Engineering quality /**

Escaped defects, rework, test automation, architecture compliance, technical debt

**Economics/**

Engineering effort variance, project margin, utilization, capacity accuracy

**Leadership and hiring/**

Manager effectiveness, critical hiring, coaching, capability growth and retention

**Client outcomes/**

Escalation trends, recovery effectiveness, satisfaction and acceptance

First 180 DaysDays 1–30 | Assess & Baseline

·      Assess assigned Salesforce portfolio, solution architecture, technical skills, current estimates, delivery health, and quality problems.

·      Establish KPI baselines and identify critical manager, staffing, and technical risks.

Days 31–90 | Establish Governance

·      Implement weekly technical portfolio reviews, solutioning approval and pre-sales handover checks, architecture reviews, estimation standards, and quality gates.

·      Begin coaching managers, correcting high-risk projects, and recruiting critical roles.

Days 91–180 | Demonstrate Results

·      Improve estimation accuracy, solution quality, milestone reliability, engineering productivity, and defect prevention.

·      Strengthen managerial ownership, fill approved critical technical roles, and present a Salesforce engineering capability roadmap.

Ideal Candidate

A hands-on Salesforce engineering and architecture leader who has progressed into portfolio delivery leadership, can own solutions from initial client discovery through successful production delivery, can challenge estimates and architecture, and can build a self-sufficient technical management organization.

title: AI Architect
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and consultative
**AI Architect**
to help clients understand, shape, and activate the potential of AI in their business. This role owns the architecture of the AI solutions we propose — across pursuits, not just within one — and is accountable for the technical credibility of what we commit to.
  
  
You will partner with sales, industry specialists, engineering, and client executives to turn priority AI use cases into architectures that are demonstrable in weeks and defensible at enterprise scale: secure, cost-aware, evaluable, and buildable by the delivery teams that inherit them.
  
  
It is deliberately a
**hands-on architect**
role. You will still open the IDE, still build the hard part of the prototype, and still debug an agent that reasons badly — while setting the patterns, guardrails, and reference architectures that everyone else builds on.
  
  
AI/Gen AI/Gen AI
  
  
Shape demand and executive conviction
  
  

* Lead discovery and architecture workshops with client business and technology leadership; set the agenda rather than respond to it.
* Identify pain points, value levers, and high-impact AI opportunities, and sequence them into a pragmatic AI roadmap (quick wins → platform investments).
* Translate ambiguous, complex client questions into solution hypotheses, target-state architecture, and a phased path to get there.
* Build AI scenarios and value frameworks that illustrate meaningful business transformation, with measurable outcomes and a defensible business case.

Own the architecture
  
  

* Own end-to-end architecture: LLM and model-portfolio selection, context engineering, retrieval and knowledge architecture, agent orchestration, microservices, integrations, data platform touchpoints, and UI.
* Set the non-functional bar and design to it — latency, throughput, unit cost per interaction, accuracy/eval thresholds, observability, safety, security, data residency, and auditability.
* Define reference architectures, agentic blueprints, and accelerator standards for the practice; govern their reuse so pursuits start at 40% rather than zero.
* Make and document build-vs-buy and platform decisions, including model routing, fine-tuning vs prompting vs retrieval, and open vs proprietary model strategy.

Prove it
  
  

* Build prototypes, storyboards, demos, accelerators, and reusable agentic blueprints — personally on the critical path, and through the FDE pod for the rest.
* Engineer and validate AI agents for reliability, reasoning, safety, and performance; establish the evaluation and red-teaming approach that lets us state quality claims with evidence.
* Lead PoCs, pilots, and phase-0 MVPs across industries, arbitrating scope so the proof lands inside the sales cycle.

Win and hand over
  
  

* Author and quality-gate client-ready content: architecture decks, SoWs, proposals, estimates, value frameworks, risk and assumption registers, and demo storylines.
* Lead technical deep-dives, security and architecture reviews, and competitive differentiation discussions; handle the hardest objections in the room.
* Refine solution narratives based on client feedback and market conditions.
* Oversee a seamless transition from sales to delivery — architecture decision records, working code, known risks, and continuity of the people involved.

Build the practice
  
  

* Create thought leadership and reusable IP; represent the firm externally at client forums, partner events, and in published material.
* Mentor AI Leads and engineering teams; grow the bench of people who can do this role.
* Collaborate with hyperscalers and product partners to craft next-generation AI-led experiences and co-funded initiatives.

**Must-have Skills And Experience**
**Architecture and platform depth**

* Proven track record architecting and shipping production-grade GenAI/agentic systems in enterprise environments — not only pilots.
* Deep command of LLM selection and evaluation, context engineering, model routing and cost control, and the trade-offs between prompting, retrieval, tool use, and fine-tuning.
* Strong microservices and integration architecture: event-driven and API-led patterns, identity and access, secrets, multi-tenancy, and integration with core enterprise systems.
* Enterprise concerns as first-class design inputs: security, privacy, data residency, model governance, responsible AI, and regulatory constraints.

**Agentic AI engineering (hands-on)**

* Hands-on working knowledge of defining and configuring prompts, instructions, tools, reasoning strategies, guardrails, memory, and orchestration in AI agent development.
* Design and debugging of multi-agent and long-horizon workflows, including failure modes, recovery, and human-in-the-loop control points.
* Strong experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, tokenization, and prompt engineering — including retrieval evaluation and knowledge-freshness strategy.

**Engineering craft (hands-on)**

* Hands-on experience creating and maintaining Python libraries; working command of LangChain (or equivalent orchestration frameworks), Hugging Face, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and locally hosted open models.
* Very strong experience developing RESTful APIs in Python with FastAPI (or similar) and integrating third-party services, UI components, and APIs.
* Hands-on Docker-based deployment, CI/CD, and disciplined use of Git/GitHub for source control and review — mandatory.
* Working knowledge of modern data platforms and their GenAI surfaces (Databricks, Snowflake Cortex, lakehouse patterns).

**Model Provider And Hyperscaler GenAI Platform Know-how**
  
  

* Broad, current understanding of the GenAI offerings across the major frontier-model providers and hyperscalers, with deep, hands-on mastery of at least one — deep enough to design on it, defend it in a client architecture review, and know where it breaks:

+ Anthropic — Claude model family, Claude API, tool use and extended thinking, Claude Agent SDK, MCP (Model Context Protocol) as an integration standard, Claude delivered via Amazon Bedrock / Vertex AI, and enterprise deployment and governance patterns.
+ OpenAI — GPT model family, Responses/Assistants APIs, Agents SDK, function calling, structured outputs, fine-tuning, batch and realtime APIs, enterprise data-handling commitments.
+ AWS — Amazon Bedrock (multi-model access, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Agents/AgentCore), SageMaker, and integration with AWS data, identity and security services.
+ Google — Gemini model family, Vertex AI (Model Garden, grounding, agent tooling, evaluation), and Gemini enterprise offerings.
+ Microsoft Azure — Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, AI Agent Service, AI Search for retrieval, and Azure-native identity, networking and compliance patterns.

* Able to construct and defend a multi-provider model strategy: capability-to-task mapping, model routing and tiering, benchmark and eval evidence, context-window and latency envelopes, unit economics, rate limits and capacity planning, deprecation and version-migration risk.
* Fluent in the enterprise decision criteria that actually settle these choices — data residency and sovereignty, tenant isolation, IP and training-data commitments, certifications and auditability, regional availability, and the client's existing cloud and licensing commitments.
* Designs for portability where it matters: provider-abstracted interfaces, gateway/routing layers, and prompt and eval assets that survive a model or vendor change, without over-abstracting to the point of losing provider-specific capability.
* Keeps pace with a fast-moving field and translates new releases into concrete client opportunity, filtering hype from what is production-ready.

**Consultative and commercial ability**

* Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business problems into crisp AI use cases with clear value hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication and articulation skills; credible with a CIO/CDO and with a client's principal engineer in the same day.
* Commercial fluency: estimation, deal shaping, pricing implications of architecture choices, and the discipline to say no to a use case that will not survive contact with production.
* Hands-on prototyping mindset — able to quickly build functional demos, agent workflows, or LLM-powered interactions that accelerate client conviction.

Good to have
  
  

* Prior experience in a pre-sales, consulting, solution-architecture, or forward-deployed engineering capacity at scale.
* Recognised depth in one or more industry domains (BFSI, healthcare/life sciences, retail/CPG, manufacturing, telecom, energy).
* Experience running partner-funded or co-innovation programmes with a hyperscaler or model provider (AWS, Microsoft, Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, NVIDIA or ISV partners), including funding programmes, early-access participation, and joint go-to-market.
* Certification on a hyperscaler AI/ML or architect track, or equivalent demonstrable platform depth.
* Experience with self-hosted / open-weight model deployment (vLLM, Bedrock or Vertex custom endpoints, on-prem GPU) for clients with strict data-boundary requirements.
* Published thought leadership, patents, open-source contributions, or conference speaking on GenAI/agentic systems.

title: Director - Application Development
description:
**About The Company**
Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners.
  
  
Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations.
  
  
Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide.
  
  
**I. The Mission**
You will lead a world-class engineering organization responsible for our core Fintech and Banking portfolios. You aren't just a leader; you are a
**technical visionary**
who ensures our systems are reliable and fast. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and elite engineering execution, pioneering an
**AI-first development culture (AIDLC)**
to set a new industry standard for productivity.
  
  
As the
**Director of Application Development**
, you will function as a high-impact technical executive. This role is designed for a technologist who can manage large-scale portfolios, lead multi-disciplinary teams (Front-end & Back-end), and navigate the complexities of the
**Fintech and Banking**
sectors.
  
  
You are expected to be a "technologist first"- a leader who can sit in an architectural review or a deep-dive debugging session and add immediate value, while simultaneously presenting digital transformation roadmaps for your portfolios.
  
  
The Director of Application Development will serve as a pivotal leader within the Netspend Product & Technology organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Leader. This highly visible Senior leadership role requires an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in building and scaling consumer products.
  
  
The Director of Application Development will shape the long-term technology vision, drive SaaS-first engineering excellence, and ensure our product's solutions remain the industry benchmark for innovation, reliability, and customer value. This leader will inspire high-performing global teams and foster strong cross-functional partnerships.
  
  
**II. The Core Mandate**

* Strategic Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management
* The Bridge: Act as the primary interface between business units and engineering. You will translate high-level commercial objectives into executable technical strategies.
* Portfolio Oversight: Manage a comprehensive portfolio of applications, ensuring that cross-functional teams are aligned, unblocked, and delivering high-value features.
* Agile Transformation: Lead the evolution of the engineering org into a high-performing, fast-paced Agile environment, optimizing for both speed-to-market and system stability.
* Technical Depth & Innovation (AIDLC)
* Hands-on Guidance: While not required to write daily production code, you must possess the technical depth of a former Solution Architect or Dev Lead. You will guide teams through complex technical hurdles and ensure code quality standards.
* AI-Augmented Engineering: A core focus will be the AIDLC (AI-driven Development Life Cycle). You will be expected to implement AI tools and frameworks to drastically enhance team productivity and developer experience.
* Cloud Strategy: Direct the architecture and migration initiatives within the AWS ecosystem, ensuring cost-efficiency, scalability, and security.
* Move Fast with Stability: Transition teams into high-performing, autonomous units that ship code daily without compromising the integrity of financial transactions.
* Metric-Driven Results: Define and track KPIs that correlate engineering output with actual business revenue and user engagement.
* Organizational Mentorship
* Leader of Leaders: Provide direct mentorship and career development for Senior Managers and Associate Directors.
* Culture of Excellence: Foster an environment of continuous learning, psychological safety, and technical curiosity.
* Bottom-Up Leadership: Empower Senior Managers and Associate Directors to take extreme ownership. Foster a culture where the best ideas win, regardless of hierarchy.

**III. Educational & Foundation (Mandatory)**

* Academic Excellence: B.Tech / B.E. from a reputed, top-tier institute or a Master of Computer Applications (MCA).

**IV. Experience & Skills**

* Years of Experience: 12+ years in Software Development with a progressive track record of leadership.
* Domain Expertise: Deep experience in Fintech and Banking (High-volume transactions, security protocols, regulatory compliance).
* Full-Stack Vision: Proven experience leading both Front-end and Back-end initiatives simultaneously.
* Technical Stack: Strong foundational knowledge in modern microservices, distributed systems, and AWS Migration.
* Communication: Elite communication skills; able to influence senior business stakeholders and inspire junior engineers.

**High-Weightage Qualifications**

* Demonstrated success in using AI to enhance team efficiency (e.g., LLM-integrated workflows, automated code synthesis, or AI-driven testing).
* Experience transitioning legacy banking systems into modern, cloud-native architectures.
* A "Consultative Mindset": The ability to analyze problems from a first-principles perspective and drive data-backed decisions.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Operational Efficiency: 30% improvement in development velocity via AIDLC tools.
* System Reliability: Maintaining 99.99% uptime for critical banking portfolios.
* Talent Retention: Reducing attrition among high-potential Senior Managers and Directors.
* Stakeholder Satisfaction: High NPS from business partners on the "transparency and predictability" of the delivery pipeline.

**V. Why This Role?**
This is a rare opportunity to build an engineering org within the high-stakes world of Finance. You will have the budget of a Tier-1 firm and the autonomy to rewrite the rules of how software is built using AI.
