title: Director, Security
description: BOLD is looking for a Director of Security to own security across a large portfolio of client-facing products. Our products run on AWS and Azure, ship at high velocity across UI and backend, and make extensive use of AI and LLMs across the customer experience. This is a builder's role, not an audit role. You will design security into our architecture, our delivery pipeline and our AI features, and lead the team that keeps it there. Compliance, certifications and penetration testing are part of the remit, but they are outcomes of a well-run program, not the program itself. We want someone who has already thought hard about what changes when a product talks to a model: prompt injection and hijacking, data leaking through model context, agents with too much authority, and attackers who now use AI too. What you'll be securing: Layer What We Run What we need from you Cloud AWS and Azure, multi-account / multi-subscriptionOne identity, policy and posture model across both cloudsCompute Kubernetes (EKS / AKS), containers, CI/CDSupply-chain integrity, runtime detection, least-privilege workloadsEdge CDNs, WAF, bot detection agentsTuned defences against scraping, credential stuffing and AI-driven botsAPIs Public and partner APIs behind API protectionDiscovery, schema enforcement, abuse and BOLA/BFLA detectionApplications Modern web front ends and backend servicesSecure-by-default frameworks and paved roads for engineersAI Extensive use of AI and LLMs in client-facing featuresAn LLM threat model, guardrails, evals and monitoring in productionJob Description ABOUT THIS TEAM BOLD Platform services team design, creates, manage and maintains the highly scalable and distributed services for the wider use of web and mobile product applications/portals/websites. The current list of services is based on Microservices architecture whose domain ranges from visitor tracking, User profiles, authentication, content and payments. Platform team uses state of the art modern technologies like .Net framework, Python, Java, SQL Server, My SQL, Graph DB, SOLR, and a lot of other tools & technologies serving millions of users with hundreds of million transactions everyday through a scalable and fault tolerant architecture. WHAT YOU’LL DO AI and LLM security: Own the threat model for every AI/LLM-powered feature, covering prompt injection and prompt hijacking (direct and indirect), jailbreaks, system-prompt and data leakage, insecure output handling, excessive agency in tool-calling, and model denial-of-wallet. AI assurance: Build adversarial evals and red-team exercises for AI features into the release process, with production monitoring for abuse and drift. Govern internal AI use, including coding assistants, agents with repo or cloud access, plugin integrations and shadow AI. Multicloud security: Set a unified security architecture across AWS and Azure: identity federation and guardrail policies. Harden Kubernetes with admission control, network policy, workload identity and runtime threat detection. Edge defences and real-time tuning: Own edge security across every client-facing product, working with Architecture and Technical Operations on real-time tuning of DDoS mitigation thresholds, rate limits, bot-score and challenge thresholds, and WAF rule sensitivity, balancing attacks blocked against false positives for real customers. API security: Run an API security program covering inventory of every endpoint, authentication and authorization patterns, rate limiting and abuse detection. Secure engineering: Build paved roads so the secure way is the easy way. Embed SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanning and SBOMs in CI/CD, secure the software supply chain, and lead design reviews and threat modelling as a peer to architects. Detection and response: Own detection engineering and incident response across cloud, Kubernetes, edge and AI layers, including runbooks for AI-specific incidents, tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews. Tooling and budget: Own the security tooling budget: build business cases, rationalise overlapping tools, negotiate with vendors and track spend against risk reduced. Partner with Architecture and Technical Operations on tooling decisions from evaluation to rollout, and agree who owns which detection thresholds during a live attack. Governance and compliance: Set direction for governance, risk and compliance, working with our in-house GRC team, which owns day-to-day delivery. Ensure compliance with GDPR, PCI DSS and the EU AI Act is a byproduct of engineering controls, with automated evidence. Risk and assurance: Make the calls on high-impact third-party risk, especially AI providers. Scope and direct penetration tests and bug bounty, and represent security to enterprise clients on strategic deals. Leadership: Build and lead a small, high-leverage team (application, cloud and AI security), work closely with our in-house GRC team, grow security champions inside engineering, and report risk posture and program metrics to executive leadership in plain business terms. WHAT YOU’LL NEED 12+ years in security, including 4+ years leading a security function in a product engineering organisation with a multi-product, client-facing portfolio, including ownership of its tooling budget. Hands-on depth in cloud security on both AWS and Azure; able to read an IAM policy, a Terraform plan and a Kubernetes manifest and spot the problem. Practical experience securing AI/LLM-powered features in production, including defending against prompt injection and hijacking. Strong application and API security background: OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10, OAuth/OIDC, authorization design and secure SDLC. title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
  
  
You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain-Specific AI Integration**
Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
  
  
Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
  
  
Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
  
  
**Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration**
Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
  
  
Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).
  
  
Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.
  
  
**Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement**
Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
  
  
Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
  
  
Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
  
  
Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Must-Have Qualifications And Experience**
Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
  
  
Technical Fluency: Deep, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE-based assistants.
  
  
Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
  
  
Background in customer-facing technical roles such as Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**Senior Engineering Manager, IT Solutions — Noida**
SMBS
  
  

* Development & Scaling
* Reports to the AVP, Development & Scaling

**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like
**what we’re saying, keep reading!**
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
SimCorp's Managed Business Services (SMBS) runs investment operations for some of the largest financial institutions in the world. Within SMBS, Development & Scaling is establishing a new IT Team in Noida to build the operational tooling, applications, integrations and data solutions that let our services scale — a cornerstone of our 2026 scalability agenda.
  
  
This is a founding role. You will be the first hire: you set the technical direction, define the roles, hire and grow a team of :5–6 full-stack developers, and own what the team ships. You are both the people manager and the team's Tech SME / Solution Architect — this is deliberately not a purely managerial role. You stay hands-on: designing solutions, reviewing code, and contributing to build on complex or foundational work, increasingly using an AI-assisted SDLC.
  
  
The team builds traditional software — operational tooling, applications, front ends and integrations (for example with SimCorp's product platform) — with a strong data-platform component built on Snowflake. You will work closely with the SMBS AI team, the Change & Upgrade engineering team (which provides shared QA), and SimCorp Platform & Infrastructure.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Founding and leading the new IT Team: defining roles, hiring, onboarding and growing :5–6 full-stack developers, with responsibility for staffing and team development.
* Acting as the team's Solution Architect — owning the technical solution framework, standards and design principles; ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, scalable and reusable.
* Translating business needs into technical designs for tooling, applications, front ends and integrations, working closely with SMBS service and delivery leaders.
* Owning the data-platform build on Snowflake — fast, reliable data in/out and integration patterns.
* Staying hands-on: solution design, code reviews, and production code on complex or foundational paths.
* Leading the day-to-day delivery cadence and release management of the team (no separate scrum/release role), with responsibility for both short-term deliverables and long-term improvements.
* Coordinating QA through the SMBS Change & Upgrade QA capability rather than a dedicated in-team function.
* Collaborating with other engineering leaders — the SMBS AI team and SimCorp Platform — on integration patterns, quality, security and delivery, keeping clear boundaries: application builds sit with this team, AI/agent solutions with the AI team.
* Establishing coding standards, testing practices and deployment patterns; providing input to the strategic direction of the IT capability in SMBS.

**What We Value**

* You are an engineer at heart, with strong professional software development experience.
* You have 5–8 years' experience leading software engineers, and demonstrated experience building or scaling a team.
* You take pride in delivering sound, production-grade software solutions.
* You have a deep understanding of core engineering practices — testing methodologies, coding, CI/CD, AI-assisted development, security and architecture — and can comprehend and guide your team's daily work.
* You have a bias for delivery: you get solutions from concept to production quickly without compromising quality.
* You build a collaborative and open culture, and work effectively across a large, international organisation at various levels.

**Technical Skills**

* Extensive experience with the .NET ecosystem (C#, .NET 6+, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs) building scalable, enterprise-grade applications.
* Full-stack proficiency: solid understanding of web application architecture (RESTful services, microservices / modular monolith, event-driven systems) plus working knowledge of modern UI frameworks (Angular, React or similar) — the team hires full-stack developers rather than dedicated front-end specialists.
* Data-platform experience, ideally Snowflake — data modelling, SQL, and building data integration and pipelines; Python for automation and integration.
* Experience building and operating solutions on Microsoft Azure; cloud-native design principles, CI/CD pipelines, observability, resilience and scalability.
* Strong software-engineering practices — API design, secure coding, performance optimisation, distributed system design.
* Familiarity with data storage technologies (SQL Server, NoSQL, caching strategies).

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to financial systems / capital-markets platforms or high-volume transactional systems.
* Experience with AI-assisted development tooling in the SDLC (e.g. Copilot, Claude).

**Nice to Have**

* You have worked in an Azure or other cloud environment.
* You have worked within the Capital Markets or another regulated domain.
* Familiarity with SimCorp One / Dimension or comparable investment-management platforms.

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
* Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually
**. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.**
At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Director- Architect
description:
**About Us**
 At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure\-to\-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start\-up. You will find a unique home here.
   

  

 And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000\. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.
   

  

 Read more about apexanalytix \- https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

****The Role****
 apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management Solutions, recognized for both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI\-native, Quantum Era\-ready platform to protect over $9\.5 trillion in annual spend.
   

  

 apexanalytix is seeking a hands\-on Architect to own the technical foundation of our platform and the applications that run on it as we scale globally.
   

  

 apexanalytix runs its own private cloud — more than 60 Kubernetes clusters across two datacenters, each declared in Git and reconciled by GitOps, networked with Cilium's eBPF datapath, and backed by Ceph. On top of that platform run our supplier management and risk products on .NET, a Go microservice estate, a React front end and a growing set of internal engineering products. Very little here is a black box: you can follow a request from a BGP\-advertised service IP, through the eBPF datapath, into a pod, into the application request pipeline, to a query against a tenant database the team migrated itself.
   

  

 This is a high\-leverage technical leadership role. The successful candidate sets architectural direction and standards across both planes — Kubernetes at fleet scale, GitOps, networking, storage, identity and observability on one side; n\-tier application architecture, multi\-tenancy, service contracts and distributed data on the other — while remaining hands\-on with the code and the cluster, and mentoring engineers across apexanalytix's global engineering teams, including the Noida, India GCC.
   

  

 The ability to reason across the infrastructure and application boundary is the defining requirement of this role. The hardest problems at apexanalytix — and the most valuable ones — live exactly on that line.
   

  

****Quick Take \-****
* Leverages deep subject\-matter expertise in private\-cloud architecture and enterprise application architecture to advise engineering leadership on platform and product strategy and trade\-offs.
* Acts as the go\-to technical authority on how apexanalytix software is built and how it runs, and on the interaction between the two.
* Partners with the Global Head of Engineering \& Infrastructure, the Head of Software Development and global engineering teams to ensure one architectural standard spans design, build and run.
* Roles and Requirements
* Infrastructure and platform architecture. Owns the architectural vision and standards for apexanalytix's private cloud: Kubernetes across bare\-metal, virtualized (KubeVirt with Cluster API and hosted control planes) and managed\-cloud footprints. Designs and evolves cluster architecture, multi\-tenancy (namespaces, RBAC, admission control, Pod Security standards), and workload placement and scheduling.
* GitOps as the only path to production. Sets direction for GitOps delivery (FluxCD, Kustomize, Helm) through a layered model — component template, shared baseline, per\-cluster overlay — so the fleet's desired state always lives in Git.
* Networking and storage. Defines standards for the Cilium eBPF networking layer (BGP control plane, LB\-IPAM, ClusterMesh, network policy, Hubble) and for Rook\-Ceph and cephadm storage (CephFS, RBD, CSI drivers, snapshots, backup and DR). Contributes to network fabric design, including QoS and buffer engineering on the 100/200/400G data\-plane fabric.
* Platform services. Sets direction for the services the fleet depends on — container registry, identity and OIDC, secrets management, certificate management — and for the Prometheus/Thanos/Grafana/Loki/Tempo observability stack.
* Application architecture. Owns architectural standards across the product estate: a .NET 10 enterprise platform (ASP.NET Core, EF Core, OData, gRPC, .NET Aspire) with a React 19 front end; a Go microservice estate with mTLS and shared contracts; and the supplier\-facing community platform.
* Multi\-tenancy and service contracts. Sets and enforces the multi\-tenancy model end to end — tenant resolution, per\-tenant data isolation, cache key discipline and the identity and access model — across both the .NET and Go estates. Owns service contract architecture: gRPC and REST/OData surface design, versioning, and backward\-compatibility discipline across independently released packages.
* Performance and resilience by design. Owns application performance architecture — data access patterns, large\-column materialization, caching topology and query\-plan discipline — and sets resilience standards including replica counts, host anti\-affinity, disruption budgets, health and dependency endpoints and graceful degradation, applied as a design gate rather than an incident finding.
* Data platform architecture. Owns the architecture of a distributed data tier spanning SQL Server, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, OceanBase, CockroachDB, Vitess, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, Snowflake and in\-memory stores. Owns the geo\-replicated database programme — distributed database architecture, migration tooling and sequencing, and the application\-side changes each migration requires — and sets standards for schema change management, index and query design across the multi\-engine estate.
* Internal engineering products. Owns the architecture of apexanalytix's internal product and tooling estate, ensuring it is held to the same standards as customer\-facing products for identity, secrets handling, observability and supportability.
* Tooling and standards. Evaluates and introduces new tooling — CI/CD, policy\-as\-code, custom static analysis, service mesh enhancements — to improve engineering velocity and platform reliability. Partners directly with engineering teams to review designs, unblock complex technical problems and ensure architectural consistency.
* Hands\-on delivery. Writes and reviews production code and configuration — C\#, Go, Helm charts, OpenTofu/Terraform, Ansible, Python and Bash automation. This role remains technically hands\-on.
* AI\-assisted engineering. apexanalytix is an AI\-first engineering organization. This role practises AI\-assisted development, extends the organization's automation capability, and mentors engineers into it. This is a core expectation of the role, not a bonus.
* Security and compliance. Ensures the platform and applications meet enterprise security and compliance requirements — RBAC, network policy, secrets management, image signing and scanning, dependency governance — in a SOC 2 and FedRAMP\-readiness environment.
* Mentoring. Mentors engineers across global teams, including the Noida, India GCC, on Kubernetes, GitOps, application architecture and cloud\-native best practice.


**Required Skills**
* 8\+ years of infrastructure/platform engineering experience, with 4\+ years of deep, hands\-on Kubernetes expertise in production environments at scale — bare\-metal experience strongly preferred, not managed\-cloud\-only.
* Strong GitOps practice (FluxCD or ArgoCD with Kustomize and Helm) and the conviction that Git should be the only path to production.
* Substantial CNI experience with Cilium (eBPF datapath, BGP control plane, LB\-IPAM, ClusterMesh, network policy, Hubble) or comparable eBPF\-based networking.
* Substantial CSI/storage experience, ideally with Ceph (Rook or cephadm): OSD/CRUSH management, CephFS and RBD, snapshots, and performance troubleshooting.
* Experience owning platform services such as a container registry, an identity provider and secrets management, plus observability at scale (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, Loki or equivalent).
* Strong Linux fundamentals (RHEL/AlmaLinux, Ubuntu or similar): systemd, kernel and sysctl tuning, and the storage and network stacks.
* Demonstrated architecture ownership of a large n\-tier enterprise application, not only operating one. Multi\-tenant SaaS strongly preferred.
* Hands\-on .NET/C\# — modern ASP.NET Core, EF Core, and the ability to read and review a production request pipeline. Equivalent depth in another managed enterprise stack will be considered when paired with a genuine willingness to work in .NET from day one.
* Hands\-on Go. A significant and growing share of the estate is written in Go; this is not optional.
* Service contract design experience — gRPC and/or REST/OData — including versioning and backward\-compatibility discipline across independently released packages.
* Distributed and geo\-replicated database architecture experience. Direct OceanBase experience is ideal; CockroachDB, Vitess, Spanner, YugabyteDB or TiDB experience transfers.
* Automation skill in OpenTofu/Terraform, Ansible, and at least one of Go, Python or Bash.
* Active, practising experience with AI\-assisted software development, including the ability to build reusable automation for other engineers and mentor them into it.
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent demonstrable depth; CKS or CKAD a plus.
* Experience operating in a B2B enterprise SaaS environment, ideally serving large enterprise customers with strict security and compliance requirements (SOC 2, FedRAMP or comparable).
* Strong communication skills; comfortable operating as a technical leader who influences without direct authority across global, distributed teams.
* Non\-negotiable versus trainable
* Non\-negotiable: hands\-on production Kubernetes at scale; genuinely hands\-on coding in at least one of C\# or Go; n\-tier application architecture ownership; practising AI\-assisted development; and the ability to reason across the infrastructure and application boundary.
* Trainable on the job: OceanBase specifically, given distributed\-database fundamentals; the apexanalytix product domain; and Cilium and Ceph specifics, given strong CNI and CSI fundamentals.
* Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis) \- Undergraduate degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical field required; graduate degree a plus but not required.


****Physical/Remote/Travel Work Environment****
* apexanalytix Global Capability Center, Noida, India.


**Scope Boundaries**
****Travel required — occasional.****
****This role holds design authority across infrastructure and applications. Line management of the engineering organization sits with the SVP, Global Head of Engineering \& Infrastructure; day\-to\-day operation of the estate with the Global IT Managed Services Leader; delivery management and release with the VP, Head of Software Development; security policy and compliance attestation with the CISO; and AI and automation delivery with a separate AI \& Automation organization.****
 Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way \- https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/
   

  

**Benefits**
 At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.
   

  

 With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

Git is the only path to production; the successful candidate runs operations through the git source and treats direct cluster mutation as a time\-boxed mitigation with the durable fix named.
* Platform services. Owns the operational health of the platform components deployed across the fleet — CNI and ingress (Cilium, Multus, MetalLB, Traefik, NGINX, Kong, external DNS, IPAM), storage and data protection (Rook\-Ceph, Longhorn, Portworx, the CSI driver set, Velero, Commvault), database operators (OceanBase, CockroachDB, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Vitess, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, Valkey, RabbitMQ, Kafka), identity and secrets (Keycloak, OpenBao, cert\-manager, policy enforcement), and the Prometheus/Thanos/Grafana/Loki/Tempo observability stack.
* Datacenter and physical infrastructure. Owns datacenter operations across both sites plus regional and cloud footprints: rack, power, cabling, provisioning, firmware and hardware lifecycle across Cisco UCS, Supermicro, Dell and NVIDIA platforms; the VMware estate; and the network fabric spanning Cisco NX\-OS and IOS\-XE, Pica8, MikroTik RouterOS, NVIDIA Cumulus and MLNX\-OS, and Aruba wireless.
* WAN, remote access and telephony. Owns the WAN edge — VRRP, IPsec, BGP and NAT across redundant appliance pairs and multiple carrier circuits — along with SSL VPN, the WireGuard overlay, the Citrix NetScaler tier fronting client access, and the enterprise PBX and dialer estate.
* Reliability and recoverability. Establishes provable backup and restore across every tenant and platform system, with dated evidence produced and witnessed independently of the accountable team. Establishes verified high availability across production — replica counts, host anti\-affinity and disruption budgets, checked continuously rather than after an incident. Owns disaster recovery posture and exercises it on a defined cadence.
* Service management. Owns end\-to\-end IT support delivery: incident, problem and change management (ITIL), major incident command, end\-user computing, asset management, access provisioning, and escalation paths into Infrastructure, Engineering and Security. Ensures a consistent, high\-quality support experience across all locations.
* Vendor and commercial governance. Leads RFP, vendor selection and contract negotiation for managed service providers and OEMs. Manages ongoing vendor and OEM performance against SLAs. Builds a vendor governance framework — QBRs, scorecards, escalation paths — giving leadership clear visibility into service health and cost.
* Budget and reporting. Owns the global infrastructure and managed\-services operating budget and drives run\-cost optimisation without compromising reliability. Provides transparent reporting on availability, incident SLAs, capacity, patch and backup posture, and cost to executive leadership, tied to the company's broader value\-creation plan.


****The Must\-Haves \-****
* 8\+ years of infrastructure and IT operations leadership experience, including direct accountability for production availability across a multi\-site estate.
* Hands\-on production Kubernetes operations experience at fleet scale — tens of clusters, not one — including cluster lifecycle, upgrades, capacity management and incident response. Bare\-metal or private\-cloud experience strongly preferred over managed\-cloud\-only.
* Working fluency with GitOps operations (FluxCD or ArgoCD with Kustomize and Helm), and the discipline that Git is the only durable path to production.
* Datacenter and physical infrastructure operations experience — server hardware lifecycle, out\-of\-band management, firmware, power and capacity planning.
* Enterprise network operations at Layer 2 and Layer 3 — BGP, MLAG/vPC, LACP, VLAN and VRRP design and troubleshooting — across more than one switch operating system. Cisco NX\-OS required; exposure to Linux\-based network operating systems (Cumulus, Pica8, SONiC, RouterOS) a strong plus.
* Storage operations experience — software\-defined storage (Ceph strongly preferred), SAN/NAS arrays, snapshots, replication, and backup and restore verification.
* Virtualization operations experience — VMware vSphere at scale, and ideally KubeVirt or another Kubernetes\-native virtualization platform.
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL\-based incident, problem and change management, ITSM platforms, and major incident command.
* Strong commercial acumen — comfortable negotiating MSP and OEM contracts and owning a budget with clear cost accountability.
* Demonstrated experience managing global, multi\-region operations, ideally including support for an India\-based Global Capability Center.
* An evidence\-driven operating style: able to describe, from direct experience, a control they proved was broken by testing it rather than by reading a status report.
* Strong communicator, able to translate operational and technical issues into business terms for executive audiences.


**Preferred**
* Experience operating in a regulated or attested environment (SOC 2, FedRAMP/StateRAMP, ISO 27001\) where recoverability and change control are audited.
* Automation ability in at least one of Python, Go, Bash or PowerShell — enough to build and review operational tooling, not only to consume it.
* Experience in a PE\-backed or private equity value\-creation context.
* Willingness to adopt AI\-assisted operations tooling; apexanalytix operates a substantial automation and agentic runbook capability.
* Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis) \- Undergraduate degree in information technology, computer science, engineering or a related field. ITIL Foundation, CKA or equivalent certification a strong plus but not required.


****Physical/Remote/Travel Work Environment****
 apexanalytix Global Capability Center, Noida, India.
   

  

****Travel required — occasional, including periodic travel to apexanalytix datacenters and other global offices.****
**Scope Boundaries**
****This role is accountable for running the estate. Platform strategy, target architecture and the capital plan sit with the SVP, Global Head of Engineering \& Infrastructure; technical design authority with the Architect; product software development with the VP, Head of Software Development; security policy and compliance attestation with the CISO; and AI and automation delivery with a separate AI \& Automation organization.****

title: UI Architect
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 UI Architect (Frontend Platform \& Micro\-frontends)
   

  

**Location:** 
 India
   

  

**Experience:** 
 15\+ Years
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Engineering Manager
   

  

**About the Role \& the Team** 
 We are building a foundational Core UI Platform Team to own, scale, and govern the frontend ecosystem for our enterprise product suite.
   

  

 As the UI Architect, you will set the technical direction for our frontend platform and guide engineering teams in building scalable, secure, and maintainable user experiences. This is a hands\-on leadership role that combines architecture, platform ownership, technical governance, and active contribution to core platform capabilities.
   

  

 Your mission is to evolve a robust frontend platform through reusable components, shared libraries, developer tooling, and CI/CD practices that help product teams deliver high\-quality software faster and more consistently.
   

  

**Success in this Role** 
 Success will be measured by:
   

  

* Adoption of shared platform capabilities.
* Reuse of common components.
* Improved engineering productivity.
* Reduced technical debt.
* Consistent architecture across teams.
* Platform reliability and performance.
* Faster onboarding of frontend engineers.
* Successful framework and dependency upgrades.


**What You Will Do (Responsibilities)**
* Frontend Platform Architecture: Own the technical vision and architectural integrity of the micro\-frontend ecosystem, including routing, shared state, configuration, and integration patterns.
* Design Systems \& Shared Libraries: Lead component\-driven architecture by evolving shared UI components, design\-system packages, and non\-visual utilities that are performant, well documented, and strongly typed.
* Hands\-on Execution: Write high\-quality, production\-ready code. Tackle the most complex technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and core feature implementations alongside your Technical Lead and UI Developers.
* Tooling \& CI/CD: Own frontend build systems and GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Improve dependency management, container builds, and code\-quality gates to support fast, reliable deployments.
* Governance \& Standards: Establish and enforce standards for code quality, automated testing (Jest, Playwright), accessibility, and security. Introduce formal processes like Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) to document technical choices.
* AI\-Assisted Engineering: Define practical standards for using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to improve frontend engineering productivity, code quality, and developer experience.
* Mentorship: Act as a force multiplier. Mentor Technical Leads and Senior UI Engineers, conduct rigorous code reviews, and elevate the overall engineering culture.


**What You Bring (Must\-Have Qualifications)**
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, including architectural ownership of enterprise\-grade frontend platforms or large\-scale UI products.
* Expert\-level React, JavaScript \& TypeScript: Deep knowledge of React architecture, rendering optimization, modern JavaScript, and advanced TypeScript patterns.
* Frontend Architecture: Proven experience designing and delivering component\-driven, micro\-frontend, or platform\-based frontend architectures. Experience with single\-spa or similar orchestration frameworks is preferred.
* SaaS \& Multi\-Tenant Architecture: Strong understanding of designing secure enterprise SaaS applications, including authentication, authorization, Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), and multi\-tenant architectures.
* State, Data \& API Management: Strong expertise in client\-side state management, data\-fetching strategies, and type\-safe client\-server API contracts across distributed UI modules.
* Build \& DevOps Expertise: Strong understanding of modern frontend build tools (Webpack, Vite) and experience writing/managing CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD highly preferred).
* Quality Engineering: Strong understanding of frontend testing strategies, including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing with tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Cypress.
* Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders, Product Managers, and Backend Architects.
* Platform Engineering Experience: Experience with monorepos, internal package publishing, design systems, Storybook, and reusable developer tooling.
* Frontend Governance: Ability to define and drive standards for theming, accessibility, linting, formatting, dependency management, and architectural consistency across multiple teams.
* AI\-Assisted Development: Hands\-on familiarity with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, or similar tools, with the ability to define practical usage patterns for engineering teams.


**Good To Have (Preferred Skills)**
* Frontend Observability: Experience instrumenting client\-side RUM, error\-tracking, and distributed tracing (e.g., OpenTelemetry) to support platform reliability metrics.
* Backend for frontend / Lightweight Service Ownership: Familiarity with lightweight Node.js, Express, or equivalent services that support frontend configuration, aggregation, or API composition.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Position Summary
   

  

 As an Enterprise Architect at Adobe, you will build the future of digital experiences by helping global organizations unlock the full potential of data, AI, and cloud technologies. You will collaborate with executive leaders to develop transformation strategies, compose enterprise architecture roadmaps, and deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted advisor, guiding clients through complex digital, data, and AI transformations. You will build scalable, secure, and future\-ready architectures that connect customer data, intelligence, content, and activation across Adobe Experience Cloud and modern cloud ecosystems.
   

  

 You will influence strategic decisions, bring collaborators together around a shared vision, and help organizations accelerate innovation while delivering outstanding customer experiences.
   

  

 Success in this role is measured by the value you build for customers. It also depends on the quality and impact of your architectural leadership. Additionally, success includes the adoption of recommended solutions and the positive relationships you develop with executives and delivery teams.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 Organizations are reimagining how they engage customers in an increasingly digital and technology\-driven world. Adobe is at the forefront of this transformation, helping businesses build personalized, connected, and intelligent experiences at scale.
   

  

 As a member of Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture group, you will:
   

  

* Work alongside executives to establish approaches for digital experience, customer data, and AI transformation.
* Build enterprise architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation across the customer journey.
* Assist organizations in embracing cloud\-native, API\-first, and event\-driven architectures through Adobe Experience Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, and major public cloud providers.
* Enable clients to accelerate innovation while reducing complexity and enhancing business value.


 This is an opportunity to influence enterprise\-scale transformation initiatives, build technology strategy, and help clients achieve lasting competitive advantage.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

 Develop Digital, Data, and AI Strategy
   

  

* Collaborate with executive and senior partners to establish a clear vision for digital experiences, customer engagement, and AI\-powered innovation.
* Translate business priorities into actionable, multi\-year architecture roadmaps that align technology investments with strategic outcomes.
* See opportunities to improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and business performance by using data, AI, and personalization.
* Define success measures, value hypotheses, and benchmarks that guide investment decisions and demonstrate impact.


 Lead Enterprise Architecture Build
   

  

* Build scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client technology ecosystems.
* Define modern data and AI architecture patterns, including customer data platforms, identity management, real\-time decisioning, and personalization.
* Establish architecture standards and guidelines for cloud\-native, API\-first, event\-driven, and microservices\-based solutions.
* Develop reference architectures that enable agility, governance, security, and long\-term scalability.
* Ensure architecture decisions support reliability, observability, performance, and business continuity.


 Drive Alignment and Transformation
   

  

* Align business strategy, enterprise architecture, and delivery execution across marketing, technology, product, analytics, and data teams.
* Establish governance frameworks, operating models, and decision\-making processes that enable balanced adoption and continuous improvement.
* Build positive relationships across client organizations, Adobe teams, and external partners to accelerate successful outcomes.
* Guide organizations through technology change while managing complexity and reducing risk.


 Influence and Encourage
   

  

* Communicate architecture vision, trade\-offs, and recommendations with clarity and confidence to executive audiences.
* Lead strategy workshops, architecture reviews, and roadmap discussions that align collaborators and build momentum for transformation.
* Advocate for data\-driven and AI\-powered experiences that build measurable value for customers and businesses.
* Serve as a leader with a point of view who helps clients navigate new technologies and evolving market trends.


 Contribute to Adobe's Growth
   

  

* Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, accelerators, and guidelines that strengthen Adobe's consulting capabilities.
* Mentor architects and consultants, encouraging a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Support strategic sales opportunities through solution building, executive presentations, and proposal development.
* Contribute to the evolution of Adobe's Enterprise Architecture practice and help build its strategic direction.


 What You Need to Succeed
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Proven success developing and leading enterprise architecture strategies for complex organizations.
* Deep expertise with enterprise architecture frameworks and integration patterns, including TOGAF, API\-first, and architectures built on connecting different services.
* Experience crafting and delivering cloud\-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or comparable cloud platforms.
* Demonstrated experience crafting AI\-enabled customer experiences and applying concepts such as large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and model evaluation.
* Understanding of AI governance, agentic architectures, observability, reliability, and responsible AI practices in enterprise environments.

* Build clean, testable Python/PySpark services and REST/FastAPI/Flask/gRPC APIs using clean\-architecture principles.

* Strong knowledge of AI agent architectures, multi\-agent systems, tool calling, memory strategies, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.

* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their AI services.
* Strong understanding of databases, data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, and AI cost optimization.

* Experience with multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, SQL agents, and advanced retrieval architectures.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, architecture documentation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business outcomes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Understanding of AI governance and security frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI Security, ISO/IEC 42001, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading enterprise AI transformation initiatives, Centers of Excellence (CoE), or AI capability building programs.
* Exposure to MLOps, DataOps, and enterprise deployment strategies for scalable AI solutions.
* Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and presenting architecture roadmaps, AI strategies, and business cases.

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

title: Senior Cloud Migration Engineer / Architect (AWS to GCP Migration)
description:
SourceFuse Technologies hiring Senior Cloud Migration Engineer / Architect (AWS to GCP Migration) with 6\+ years of experience.
 



  





**Preferred Location\- Noida/Mohali** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**Migration Strategy and Delivery Leadership** 



* Own the end to end technical strategy for the AWS to GCP migration, including target architecture, migration sequencing, and cutover approach.
* Produce and maintain the Technical Design Document (TDD), including low level component diagrams, at a level of detail a client engineering team can implement against.
* Establish and maintain a Key Design Decision (KDD) log capturing the rationale for major architecture choices, for example service equivalency decisions such as Cloud Run versus other compute options.
* Build and maintain a Migration and Rollback Plan, and an accurate, current Component Inventory of everything in scope for migration.
* Run weekly governance and status reporting, and maintain a Deliverables and Acceptances Log so the client always has a clear, current record of what has been delivered and approved.



  





**Migration Execution** 



* Diagnose and resolve codebase divergence between environments, including establishing a snapshot and reconciliation approach where none currently exists.
* Lead migration of core services, including compute, container workloads, and identity/authentication, from the source cloud to GCP equivalents.
* Own data migration validation where the target uses a different database engine than the source (for example, a document or key\-value store migration such as DynamoDB to Firestore), including building or reviewing validation scripts and consistency reports.
* Define and implement a cross\-cloud connectivity approach (private networking between environments) for the duration of the migration.
* Define the scope and implementation of any cross\-cloud abstraction layer required to keep the platform portable during and after migration.
* Plan and execute large scale data and feed migrations (dozens of independent feeds or integrations), with a clear enablement and validation package for each.
* Migrate logging and observability tooling, for example a self\-managed ELK stack, to GCP native or GCP\-compatible equivalents, with log routing fully validated before cutover.



  





**Infrastructure and Compatibility** 



* Build and maintain the target GCP landing zone and core infrastructure using IaC, Terraform preferred, so environments are repeatable, reviewable, and version controlled.
* Own the CI/CD pipeline build for the new environment.
* Drive remediation of the service compatibility assessment, translating flagged incompatible services into a prioritized, sequenced backlog ahead of cutover.
* Review pull requests from client engineers where the client team is doing migration work in parallel, and keep that work aligned to the agreed target design.



  





**Cutover and Post\-Migration** 



* Plan and lead the production cutover, including go and no go criteria, rollback triggers, and a data consistency and parity validation approach.
* Produce platform documentation and operational runbooks, and lead technical handover and enablement sessions for the client's internal team.
* Provide a defined period of post\-cutover expert advisory support, including an operational protocol and escalation matrix.



  





**Required Skills and Experience** 



* Proven experience leading at least one large scale, production cloud migration end to end, from planning through cutover, ideally cross\-cloud.
* Deep, hands on GCP experience across compute (Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, App Engine), data and storage (Firestore, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Bigtable, Memorystore), and networking (VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS).
* Working familiarity with AWS is useful for reading and reasoning about the source environment, for example Cognito, DynamoDB, and Lambda, though deep AWS expertise is not required for this role.
* Advanced Terraform experience, including reusable modules, state management, and automated deployment workflows.
* Experience migrating between different database engines, including designing or validating data consistency and correctness checks.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across distributed systems, using Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Audit Logs for root cause analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear technical design documentation, and to run structured governance and status reporting for a client or stakeholder audience.
* Comfortable owning ambiguous, partially defined scope and turning it into a documented, sequenced plan under time pressure.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience migrating identity and authentication between cloud providers, for example Cognito to an equivalent GCP or third party identity service.
* Experience migrating self\-managed Elasticsearch or ELK deployments to managed or cloud native alternatives.
* Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals, such as IAM, least privilege, Secret Manager, and VPC Service Controls, sufficient to keep the migrated environment secure by design. This is not primarily a security hardening role.
* Experience standing up a post go\-live managed services capability: ongoing monitoring, operational efficiency improvements, and automated operational actions.
* Experience with data sovereignty sensitive or regulated workloads, and with multi\-region deployments.

title: Technical Solns.Arch. Specialist Advisor
description:
**Req ID:** 
 387469
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Technical Solns.Arch. Specialist Advisor to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* L4 Technical Support \& Troubleshooting


 Act as the highest\-level technical escalation point for Imprivata\-related incidents.
   

  

 Troubleshoot complex authentication, SSO, agent, appliance and application integration issues.
   

  

 Perform detailed analysis of Imprivata logs, Windows event logs, authentication flows and network traces.
   

  

 Conduct root\-cause analysis for recurring and high\-severity incidents.
   

  

 Provide permanent fixes rather than workaround\-based resolutions.
   

  

 Support major incidents and participate in technical bridge calls.
   

  

 Work with Imprivata Support/Product Engineering for complex product defects.
   

  

* Imprivata Platform Engineering


 Administer and engineer enterprise Imprivata EAM/OneSign environments.
   

  

 Manage Imprivata appliances, enterprise configuration and sites.
   

  

 Configure and maintain enterprise\-wide policies and administrative settings.
   

  

 Manage Imprivata agents and endpoint deployments.
   

  

 Monitor platform health, performance and availability.
   

  

 Analyze system capacity and identify potential performance bottlenecks.
   

  

 Maintain platform resiliency and business continuity.
   

  

 Imprivata's enterprise architecture uses multiple appliances that synchronize databases and share users, policies and enrollments, making appliance/enterprise design and resiliency important areas for an L4 engineer.
   

  

* SSO \& Application Integration


 Design, configure and troubleshoot SSO integrations for:
   

  

 Web applications
   

  

 Windows/client\-server applications
   

  

 Legacy applications
   

  

 SAML applications
   

  

 Modern application environments
   

  

 Create and maintain application profiles.
   

  

 Troubleshoot credential capture/injection and application authentication issues.
   

  

 Analyze application\-specific SSO failures.
   

  

 Support integration with enterprise identity platforms such as Active Directory and Entra ID.
   

  

 Provide technical guidance for new application onboarding.
   

  

 Imprivata supports SSO across legacy, client/server, SAML and web applications.
   

  

* Authentication \& MFA


 Design and troubleshoot authentication policies.
   

  

 Support proximity cards, smart cards, biometrics, FIDO/security keys, OTP and other supported authentication mechanisms.
   

  

 Troubleshoot authentication and re\-authentication issues.
   

  

 Support passwordless and MFA implementations.
   

  

 Analyze authentication failures across endpoint, Imprivata and identity infrastructure.
   

  

 Support advanced authentication use cases and policy\-based access.
   

  

 Current Imprivata EAM documentation includes multiple authentication methods and supports both endpoint and virtual\-channel authentication scenarios.
   

  

* VDI / Shared Workstation Support


 Provide expert support for Imprivata deployments across:
   

  

 Citrix
   

  

 VMware Horizon
   

  

 Azure Virtual Desktop / supported virtual environments
   

  

 Thin/zero clients
   

  

 Shared workstations
   

  

 Troubleshoot fast\-user\-switching and session\-related issues.
   

  

 Support roaming users and shared\-device authentication.
   

  

 Analyze endpoint and virtual\-channel authentication issues.
   

  

* Upgrades, Patching \& Migration


 Lead Imprivata platform upgrades and patching activities.
   

  

 Perform upgrade impact assessments.
   

  

 Validate compatibility across supported components and endpoint environments.
   

  

 Develop upgrade and rollback plans.
   

  

 Conduct pre\- and post\-upgrade health checks.
   

  

 Support migration between supported Imprivata platform versions/environments.
   

  

 Coordinate with infrastructure, endpoint, network and application teams.
   

  

 The current Imprivata documentation includes active\-version release documentation and supported\-component references, so the L4 role should be comfortable assessing version/component compatibility before upgrades.
   

  

* Architecture \& Engineering


 Provide technical architecture for Imprivata deployments.
   

  

 Review enterprise topology, appliance placement and site design.
   

  

 Define HA/DR and resiliency strategies.
   

  

 Review authentication architecture and dependencies.
   

  

 Perform technical design reviews for new implementations.
   

  

 Prepare HLD/LLD and implementation documents.
   

  

 Identify platform limitations and recommend appropriate solutions.
   

  

 Provide technical recommendations to architects and project teams.
   

  

* Problem Management \& Continuous Improvement


 Identify recurring incidents and perform trend analysis.
   

  

 Lead Problem Management for major recurring issues.
   

  

 Develop permanent remediation plans.
   

  

 Automate repetitive administrative and operational activities where possible.
   

  

 Improve monitoring and alerting.
   

  

 Develop operational dashboards and health\-check mechanisms.
   

  

 Review platform performance and capacity periodically.
   

  

* Vendor Management


 Act as the primary technical interface with Imprivata Support.
   

  

 Raise and manage product defects and complex technical cases.
   

  

 Provide detailed logs, troubleshooting evidence and RCA information.
   

  

 Track vendor fixes and recommended workarounds.
   

  

 Validate fixes before production implementation.
   

  

 Participate in technical discussions with Imprivata engineering teams.
   

  

* Documentation \& Knowledge Management


 Create and maintain:
   

  

 HLD/LLD
   

  

 SOPs
   

  

 Runbooks
   

  

 Troubleshooting guides
   

  

 Knowledge articles
   

  

 Upgrade procedures
   

  

 DR procedures
   

  

 Application onboarding standards
   

  

 Operational health\-check procedures
   

  

 Conduct KT and technical training for L1/L2/L3 teams.
   

  

 Mentor junior Imprivata engineers.

title: Solutions Architect, AWS India Public Sector
description:
**Description**
 Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of Amazon Web Services India Private Limited. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTech startups including India\-based Unicorns, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).
   

  

 We are known for our customer obsession. Our solutions architecture teams are on the front line of helping customers succeed using AWS technologies. Our team members leverage their deep knowledge of AWS technologies in collaboration with our sales and partner teams to impact how solutions are proposed, architected and implemented for clients. Helping make customer success a reality and seeing the impact in real\-time drives our teams to explore new frontiers in leveraging AWS cloud for both commercial and public sector organizations.
   

  

 If you have worked with Amazon Web Services technologies or have AWS certifications you would like to leverage, we will help you maximize the impact of your skills and knowledge. Along the way, you’ll share with and learn from talented team members all focused on helping customers explore the benefits of moving from on\-premise infrastructure to the cloud.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a solutions architect you will provide a consistent approach for customers and partners to evaluate architectures, and implement designs that will scale over time based on five pillars of the AWS Well\-Architected Framework — operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization.
   

  

 You will do well in this role if you demonstrate excellent customer\-facing communication skills representing technical solutions at senior leadership levels. You thrive on diving deep into complex technology environments and express these as industry standard architecture diagrams and well\-articulated solution narratives. You will be right at home if you stay updated on latest technology trends and have a sense of urgency and hunger for learning more about customer business and relevant technology solutions across industries. Solutions architects love to travel, spending time with diverse customers, small and large, self\-manage high intensity context switching between competing priorities, and demonstrate a sense of urgency to deliver results.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Delivering to primary responsibilities of a solutions architect you will 1\) establish technical credibility in sales cycles for Amazon platforms, technologies, and the company, by collaborating with the sales team to win new business; 2\) capture and convey best practices and provide prescriptive guidance around application and systems design on the Amazon platforms and technologies, via direct customer and partner interaction, development of technical content, events, evangelism, training, and operational event support; and 3\) help drive the evolution of the Amazon platforms and technologies by providing direct input and feedback from the field to the engineering teams developing these offerings. Finally, tenured team members are tasked with recruiting, hiring, and developing top SA talent; managing and applying that resource in a prudent and efficient way; and driving cross\-organizational initiatives related to the areas identified above.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You’re surrounded by innovation. You’re empowered with a lot of ownership. Your growth is accelerated. The work is challenging. You have a voice here and are encouraged to use it. Your experience and career development is in your hands. We live our leadership principles every day. At Amazon, it's always "Day 1".
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 2\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working within software development or Internet\-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- AWS India \- Delhi
   

  

 Job ID: A10450089
